title: Development Tribunal decision 24-17: Class 3 short-term accommodation alterations; fire engineering brief relied on a Building Act s 61 route for the rest of the building (Cairns)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.
code_edition: NCC Volume 1 2016 (BCA), as cited (para 17, p. 5); QDC MP2.1 (Budget Accommodation) also cited
document_type: Development Tribunal decision notice (Sustainable Planning Act 2009 s 564 / Planning Act 2016 s 254), Queensland
document_date: Decision notice dated 24 Jan 2018 (PDF p. 8); hearings 23 Aug 2017 and 7 Dec 2017 (p. 1)

facts.text: QFES, as advice agency under Sustainable Planning Act 2009 s 528, appealed the assessment manager's decision to omit QFES advice from a building approval for alterations at a Cairns site (address on p. 1).
The notice describes an existing Class 3 short-term accommodation building being altered.

The original fire engineering brief (22 Dec 2016) proposed one performance solution for protection of corridor openings and referred to s 61 of the Building Act 1975 for the remainder of the building.
QFES's comments (31 Jan 2017) did not support the proposal, and QFES questioned applying s 61 to the rest of the building for safety reasons.
The notice records the view that earlier QDC MP2.1 (Budget Accommodation) approval does not imply the building is compliant.
A subsequent fire engineering report (12 Apr 2017) was submitted for advice-agency assessment; the assessment manager's decision notice is dated 16 May 2017.
The tribunal set aside the assessment manager's decision and replaced it with a decision refusing the application.
